form.title: ハーネスご意見アンケート

questions.prompt: このハーネスで動きづらかったことは？
解釈に迷った、または推測して進めたことは？
不要・過剰だった指示、SKILL、工程は？
無かったため困ったSKILL・機能は？
このハーネスのおかげで上手くできたことは？
次回同じ仕事をするなら何を変えたい？
その他、ワイへの実装依頼・ご意見

context.observation_scope: M08-S01 offline inspection, build/test, independent review; no database access or Git push

answers.ambiguous: No ambiguity in the immediate issue boundary. A live PostgreSQL run is not included in general DB access authorization; this issue's integration test must not be run without explicit scoped approval.
answers.excessive: The startup reconciliation had to compare a large Issues.md with current Git status, receipts, and existing memory notes. Independent review remains important, but a compact current-issue evidence summary would reduce repeated scanning.
answers.hard-to-operate: The mixed dirty worktree includes unrelated files, so it is not safe to commit/push a whole tree. Issue-specific Git isolation and stage review remain manual. Database evidence is blocked pending explicit authorization.
answers.helpful: The dependency planner, lint, offline Go/Python tests, and an independent source verifier exposed a clear boundary: implementation and static checks pass, but actual PostgreSQL behavior is still unverified. The build-tagged test refuses any database other than paddock_test.
answers.missing: A safe per-issue worktree/commit isolation helper and an explicit authorization receipt for a narrowly scoped disposable-database integration run would help.
answers.next-time: At resume, compare local and remote Cursor, inspect worktree ownership, identify READY issues, then run offline checks and independent review. Ask before DB integration; do not mark DONE or push until acceptance evidence and an isolated commit are available.
answers.other: M08-S01 remains WIP pending authorized PostgreSQL migration/integration evidence. M02-S03 source review also advises it remain IMPLEMENTED until actual role-level behavior is tested. This is agent observation, not user-authored feedback.
